findings.summary: The pinned C wrapper increments a signed32 start for Fortran indexing, so direct dispatch of INT32_MAX on nonempty strings has no defined C result.

routines.edgeAssessment: Observe first-match order with empty, all-empty, blank, Unicode and duplicate rows, stride changes, partial layout validation and owned snapshots.
routines.errorAssessment: All representable search misses return −1 without setting SPICE failure. NUL, malformed UTF-16 and non-string arguments are wrapper representation errors. Public row counts and widths are inferred. A non-null sentinel and two-byte minimum avoid invalid-pointer/stride calls. Sparse and oversized arrays fail before dispatch.

findings.summary: The pinned SpiceyPy wrapper derives its stride from Python character counts, has no maximum on an empty sequence, and derives a one-byte stride for all-empty rows. These layouts cannot cover all public byte-table inputs.
findings.repair: Call the independently loaded esrchc_c with an explicit byte-sized rectangular table, its reviewed signed integer ABI and a non-null sentinel for zero rows. Cross-check the ordinary wrapper on eligible nonempty ASCII rows. Node and WASM retain complete individually terminated rows.
